title: metrics catalog
description: What each metric name means and how a verdict checks it. One format for the built-in catalog (evidence-core, shipped with evidence-cli) and for every producer catalog. A producer snapshots its catalog into the pack at meta/metrics-catalog.yaml and records it in run.yaml `metrics_catalog`. Producer metrics are reached in a policy as metrics.<name>; built-in names are unprefixed and reserved. See decision 0048.

version.description: Catalog version: an integer, or a dot-separated numeric string. Compared numerically by segment against a policy's `requires.version`.

min_producer.description: Lowest producer version that writes every fact this catalog version reads. Used by the service that hands catalogs out; the verdict ignores it.

type.description: Fixes the value shape and the operators a gate may use. Integer kinds (count, integer, bytes) and number kinds (ms, currency) take equals/min/max/range/in; fraction kinds (ratio, percentage, decimal) take min/max/range; string kinds (string, enum) take equals/in.

range.description: Inclusive bounds every value must fall within; a value outside errors the gate.

values.description: The allowed values of an enum metric.

per_test.description: true when a gate may narrow the metric to some tests with `where`.

verify.description: How the verdict obtains the value. `stored` trusts run.yaml.metrics.<name>; `file` reads a dot-path from a YAML/JSON file in the pack; `aggregate` folds a per-test value over tests/*/…; `expr` evaluates CEL over the pack facts.

file.description: Pack-root-relative .yaml/.yml/.json file, contained in the pack.

over.description: Per-test file the value is read from, as tests/*/<file>. Default tests/*/result.yaml.

value.description: CEL over `test` and `file` giving the per-test value.

where.description: A bool CEL expression over `test` and `file`; only tests it holds for are folded. A non-bool result errors the gate.

merge.description: How the metric resolves on a merged pack. sum/min/max/mean combine every source's stored value, each checked for type, unit and range first; recompute re-runs an aggregate/expr over the merged tests; none (the default) errors a gate on it.
